programme.desc: Former CIA agent Frank Moses and his team of hapless heroes are tasked with finding a dangerous nuclear weapon

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (2014)
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it's up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O'Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: On a mission to protect Earth, the battle-scarred and broken Bumblebee is found and repaired by a teenager named Charlie. They must work together to save the planet from the evil Decepticons in this action-packed adventure for the whole family.

programme.title: What's Eating Gilbert Grape
programme.desc: Gilbert Grape (Johnny Depp) is a small-town young man with a lot of responsibility. Chief among his concerns are his mother (Darlene Cates), who is so overweight that she can't leave the house, and his mentally impaired younger brother, Arnie (Leonardo DiCaprio), who has a knack for finding trouble. Settled into a job at a grocery store and an ongoing affair with local woman Betty Carver (Mary Steenburgen), Gilbert finally has his life shaken up by the free-spirited Becky (Juliette Lewis).

programme.title: Seabiscuit
programme.desc: In the midst of the Great Depression, a businessman (Jeff Bridges) coping with the tragic death of his son, a jockey with a history of brutal injuries (Tobey Maguire) and a down-and-out horse trainer (Chris Cooper) team up to help Seabiscuit, a temperamental, undersized racehorse. At first the horse struggles to win, but eventually Seabiscuit becomes one of the most successful thoroughbreds of all time, and inspires a nation at a time when it needs it most.

programme.title: The Fighter
programme.desc: For Micky Ward (Mark Wahlberg), boxing is a family affair. His tough-as-nails mother is his manager. His half-brother, Dicky (Christian Bale), once a promising boxer himself, is his very unreliable trainer. Despite Micky's hard work, he is losing and, when the latest fight nearly kills him, he follows his girlfriend's advice and splits from the family. Then Micky becomes a contender for the world title and he -- and his family -- earns a shot at redemption.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: In 1999, Ken Carter (Samuel L. Jackson) returns to his old high school in Richmond, California, to get the basketball team into shape. With tough rules and academic discipline, he succeeds in setting the players on a winning streak. But when their grades start to suffer, Carter locks them out of the gym and shuts down their championship season. When he is criticized by the players and their parents, he sticks to his guns, determined that they excel in class as well as on the court.

programme.title: Bless Me, Ultima
programme.desc: A young boy grapples with questions about his destiny and the powers of a spiritual woman in WWII New Mexico.

programme.title: Touch The Top Of The World
programme.desc: The true-life story of the first blind man ever to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

programme.title: Cold Comes The Night
programme.desc: A strugglilng motel owner and her daughter are taken hostage by a nearly blind criminal.

programme.title: U-Turn
programme.desc: A small-time gambler gets more than he bargained for when his car breaks down near a remote desert town.

programme.title: Born Yesterday
programme.desc: Brassy blonde moll Billie Dawn (Judy Holliday) hits Washington, D.C., with her unscrupulous millionaire sugar daddy, Harry Brock (Broderick Crawford), and his sleazy lawyer, Jim Devery (Howard St. John), who has been pressuring Harry to marry Billie by pointing out that a wife cannot be forced to testify against her husband. In an effort to make Billie more socially acceptable, Harry hires journalist Paul Verrall (William Holden) to smarten her up -- and sparks soon fly between the pair.

programme.title: Bell, Book and Candle
programme.desc: In the late 1950s, Gillian Holroyd (Kim Novak) is a modern-day witch living in New York City's Greenwich Village. When she encounters charming publisher Shepherd Henderson (James Stewart), she decides to make him hers by casting a love spell. Gillian takes added pleasure in doing so because Henderson is engaged to her old college rival (Janice Rule). However, Gillian finds herself actually falling for Shepherd, which poses a problem: She will lose her powers if she falls in love.

programme.title: Boots Malone
programme.desc: Has-been agent Boots Malone (William Holden) is dodging his creditors and living on the edge of the horse racing world when wealthy teenager Tommy Gibson (Johnny Stewart) asks Malone to take him under his wing as a jockey-in-training. While trying to stay one step ahead of Matson (Hugh Sanders), a well-connected gambler he owes money to, Malone and his partner, Stash (Stanley Clements), introduce the idealistic Tommy to the seedy underbelly of horse racing, where cons and tricks rule.

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Return to rockin' Rydell High for a whole new term! It's 1961, two years after the original "Grease" gang graduated, and there's a new crop of seniors – and new members of the coolest cliques on campus.

programme.title: Kingpin
programme.desc: A star bowler whose career was prematurely "cut off" hopes to ride a new prodigy to success and riches.

programme.title: Clue
programme.desc: Meet all the notorious suspects and discover all their foul playthings. You'll love their dastardly doings as the bodies and the laughs pile up before your eyes. Featuring all three surprise endings!!

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Carlito's Way
programme.desc: A free man after years in prison, Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld. Reconnecting with his dancer girlfriend, Gail, Carlito gets entangled in the shady dealings of his friend Dave Kleinfeld, who also serves as his lawyer. When Carlito and Kleinfeld run afoul of shifty gangster Benny Blanco, it sets them on a dangerous path.

programme.title: Fighting
programme.desc: Shawn MacArthur (Channing Tatum) barely makes a living selling counterfeit goods on the streets of New York. But he has a natural talent for street fighting, which con-man Harvey Boarden (Terrence Howard) wants to put to good use. Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.title: The Kingdom
programme.desc: Charged with the most important assignment of his career, federal agent Ron Fleury has one week to assemble a team, infiltrate and destroy a terrorist cell based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Culture shock and opposition from local law enforcement combine to hinder his progress and that of his elite team, but a sympathetic Saudi police captain becomes an unexpected comrade-in-arms.

programme.title: Assault on Precinct 13
programme.desc: While en route to prison, a bus carrying criminals Marion (Laurence Fishburne), Beck (John Leguizamo) and Anna (Aisha Hinds) is rerouted to Detroit's soon-to-be-closed Precinct 13 because of a dangerous winter storm. All communications with the outside world are cut off, and Jake (Ethan Hawke), an emotionally volatile police sergeant who is haunted by his past, is forced to work with the criminals in order to survive an attack on the precinct by a group of armed men.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tenn., by murdering young women, and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Blunt Force Trauma
programme.desc: John (Ryan Kwanten), a modern duelist, seeks a match with the reigning champion (Mickey Rourke) while Colt (Freida Pinto) seeks revenge for her dead brother.

programme.title: Planning for Joy
programme.desc: Sparks fly when Hazel works with trivia host Theo to promote her new subscription box.

programme.title: Best Friend From Heaven
programme.desc: When her dog is killed, Tara cancels her wedding. But her dog's ghost and her small town have a surprise.

programme.title: Love at First Like
programme.desc: A journalist covering the Don Juan of dating apps ends up finding there's more than meets the eye.

programme.title: Inspiring Love
programme.desc: When Isla's art unexpectedly sells to Mark, a second commission sees them falling in love.

programme.title: The Plot
programme.desc: Young-il and his team are hired to assassinate a leading candidate for attorney general. But when their meticulously planned hit goes wrong, Young-il is left unsure who he can trust.

programme.title: The Grand Heist
programme.desc: When corrupt officials corner the ice market a gang of 11 professionals of various fields sets out on a mission to rob ice blocks from their storage.

programme.title: Love Lies
programme.desc: Two friends fall apart as they compete their love for music romance and the chance to become Joseon's voice.

programme.title: The Recon
programme.desc: One day at early dawn a search unit near the DMZ the front line is on alert. It was because a soldier from another unit's GP ran away to DMZ with a gun. Under Commander Baek the 3rd platoon members led by First Lieutenant Cho are put into the operation to arrest the deserter. The search begins and at the same time First Lieutenant Lim's dead body is found at the unit's official residence. The accident is reported to the Division Headquarters and Captain Kang who is about to be discharged arrives at the search unit with an army surgeon. The commander and the army surgeon are rushing to conclude Lim's case with suicide but Kang suspects that there is a deep secret in this accident. At that time the soldiers who were put into the operations get killed one by one and the dark truth between Lim's death and the deserter search operation is revealed.

programme.title: Intentions
programme.desc: Jade is an ambitious career-woman, dreaming of a VP title and to go up against her male counterparts. She dreams of finding a man her equal, but wants to focus on her career. programme.title: Duke Ellington
programme.sub-title: Duke Ellington: Jazz from Newport, Brussels, 1973
programme.desc: In 1956, Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed a legendary set at the third annual Newport Jazz Festival. It was tenor saxophonist Paul Gonsalves' outstanding 27-chorus solo on “Diminuendo and Crescendo in Blue” that revitalized Ellington's career. The success generated during that performance carried him for the rest of his life. By 1973, festivals carrying the Newport name were organized all over the world. Less than a year before his death, Ellington and his Orchestra, with Gonsalves still in the fold, appeared in Brussels to deliver a timeless performance before a highly appreciative crowd.

programme.title: Ray Charles & The Raelettes
programme.sub-title: Ray Charles and the Raelettes - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1980, American soul legend Ray Charles brought the Raelettes and the Ray Charles Orchestra to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. With the full force of these two groups behind him, Charles showed why throughout his storied career he has been viewed as one of the most recognizable voices in music.

programme.title: Spyro Gyra
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, the American jazz fusion band Spyro Gyra took the stage at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Having struck gold with their album "Morning Dance" just a few years prior, they played a slick set with exuberant energy.

programme.title: Coleman Hawkins
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Wayne Shorter
programme.sub-title: Wayne Shorter Quintet - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano. Together with pianist Jim Beard, guitarist David Gilmore, bassist Alphonso Johnson, and drummer Rodney van Holmes, Shorter shows he is still at his best.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist's career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs “Autumn Leaves”, “Hackensack”, “My Favorite Things”, “I Want To Talk About You”, “Vigil”, and “Naima”. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: Art Farmer, Jim Hall, Steve Swallow & Pete La Roca
programme.sub-title: The Art Farmer Quartet live In England
programme.desc: Art Farmer: Live in '64 highlights an amazing one-hour concert featuring the great flugelhornist in his prime. Farmer's band includes legendary guitarist Jim Hall (fresh from Sonny Rollins' band), drummer Pete LaRoca, and Steve Swallow on bass. The legendary ensemble plays both standards and originals with ease and finesse and highlights why Farmer was considered one of the most innovative horn players in all of jazz.

programme.title: Bill Evans
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Isabelle Faust
programme.sub-title: Bach - Partita No. 2 and Sonata No. 3
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs two of J. S. Bach's incredible works for solo violin: Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004), and Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005). Both works are part of the composer's well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Partita No. 2 is made up of four dance movements, concluded by its famous Chaconne, a monumental piece within the violin repertoire. In this Chaconne, Bach develops a series of continuous variations from a theme, exploring a complex range of harmonic possibilities. Sonata No. 3 includes an extensive fugue in which Bach employs many contrapuntal techniques. In this wonderful performance, Faust shows her mastery of Bach's technically challenging pieces. This performance was recorded at St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, Germany, in 2020.

programme.title: Kevin John Edusei
programme.desc: In October 2020, German conductor Kevin John Edusei made his London Symphony Orchestra debut and leads the orchestra in a beautiful performance of the suite from Mendelssohn's “A Midsummer Night's Dream”, Boulanger's “D'un matin de printemps” and Schumann's 'Spring' Symphony. Edusei is regularly praised for the drama and tension that he brings to his music-making, and for his clear sense of architecture and attention to detail.

programme.title: Evgeny Kissin, Nikolai Demidenko, Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra & Antoni Wit
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010. Chopin composed the second concerto one year before the Concerto No. 1 and completed both works at the age of 20, before leaving his home country Poland and moving to Paris.

programme.title: Jonathon Heyward & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: American conductor Jonathon Heyward makes his debut with the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) with this performance of Antonín Dvořák's beloved Symphony No. 9 in E minor, Op. 95, "From the New World". Composed during Dvořák's stay in the United States, the work blends Bohemian warmth with the rhythms and spirit of American musical traditions. A deeply expressive and melodic masterpiece, it remains one of the most popular symphonies of all time. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke's on Old Street in London, UK, on September 30, 2020.

programme.title: Elena Bashkirova, Juliane Banse, Emmanuel Pahud & Claudio Bohorquez
programme.desc: The extraordinarily talented pianist Elena Bashkirova has been president of the Felix Mendelssohn-Bartholdy Foundation in Leipzig since October 2020, succeeding legendary conductor Kurt Masur. In this concert at the Mendelssohn House in Leipzig, Bashkirova is joined by soprano Juliane Banse, flutist Emmanuel Pahud, cellist Claudio Bohórquez, clarinettist Karl-Heinz Steffens, and pianist Ohad Ben-Ari in a chamber music program dedicated to the music of Mendelssohn and his sister Fanny Hensel. The program opens with Mendelssohn's Piano Trio in D minor, Op. 49. This is followed by a selection of songs: Mendelssohn's Schilflied ‘Auf dem Teich, dem regungslosen', Op. 71 No. 4, and Reiselied ‘Der Herbstwind rüttelt die Bäume', Op. 34 No. 6 Hensel's Vorwurf, Op. 10 No. 2 Verlust, Op. 9 No. 10 and Sehnsucht, Op. 9 No. 7 Mendelssohn's ‘Allnächtlich im Traume seh ich dich', Op. 86 No. 4 ‘Die Liebende schreibt', Op. 86 No. 3 and Nachtlied ‘Vergangen ist der lichte Tag', Op. 71 No. 6. The program continues with Mendelssohn's Seven Songs without Words, for piano four-hands (Op. 62 Nos. 1-6, and Op. 67 No. 1), and comes to a close with Mendelssohn's Three pieces for clarinet, violoncello and piano (arr. Ernst Naumann), comprising Prelude, Op. 35 No. 4, Songs without Words, Op. 53 No. 2, and Duet, Op. 38 No. 6. This performance was recorded in November 2020.

programme.title: Hans Zimmer
programme.desc: Hans Zimmer is one of the most successful film music composers working today. His multi-award winning career reaches back to the mid-eighties and he has developed close working relationships with renowned directors such as Ridley Scott, Tony Scott, Michael Bay, Ron Howard, Gore Verbinski and Christopher Nolan. His credits include some of the biggest blockbuster movies and most acclaimed TV series of all time. This concert was filmed on 7th May 2016 in Prague during Hans Zimmer's hugely successful European concert tour. Hans was accompanied by a band, orchestra and choir, 72 musicians in total, including guest guitarist Johnny Marr. The staging was spectacular with a ground breaking light show, stunning visuals and a state of the art sound system. With Hans Zimmer performing on multiple instruments and giving introductory insights to many of the pieces, this show is a treat for lovers of both great music and great movies.

programme.title: Diana Krall
programme.desc: Diana Krall has had a long time fascination with bossa nova, a type of music which perfectly suits her sophisticated yet sensual style. This culminated in her new studio album 'Quiet Nights' (released by Verve in spring 2009) and in this stunning concert filmed in the home of the bossa nova, Rio de Janeiro, in November 2008. Accompanied by her band and an orchestra, Diana Krall delivers a superb live performance of standards in true bossa nova style but clearly bearing her unique stamp. This concert captures Diana Krall at her scintillating best.

programme.title: Deep Purple
programme.desc: Filmed in the spectacular surroundings of the Arena di Verona, a Roman amphitheater originally built in 30 AD, this concert from the summer of 2011 sees Deep Purple joined on stage by a full symphony orchestra for performances of all their classic tracks. Deep Purple remains one of the finest hard rock bands on the planet and are undoubtedly at their best when performing live. Here, the orchestral arrangements give an added depth and range to the familiar songs. The band responds to both playing with the orchestra and performing in such a historical location to deliver a brilliant show in front of a huge and enthusiastic crowd.

programme.title: Spotlight [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 2001, editor Marty Baron of The Boston Globe assigns a team of journalists to investigate allegations against John Geoghan, an unfrocked priest accused of molesting more than 80 boys. Led by editor Walter "Robby" Robinson (Michael Keaton), reporters Michael Rezendes (Mark Ruffalo), Matt Carroll and Sacha Pfeiffer interview victims and try to unseal sensitive documents. The reporters make it their mission to provide proof of a cover-up of sexual abuse within the Roman Catholic Church.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Dead Awake
programme.desc: Kate Bowman is a by-the-books social worker who is investigating a series of mysterious deaths. Each victim suffered from sleep paralysis, a frightening ailment that immobilizes its victims as they dream. Kate is approached by an unorthodox doctor who warns of an evil entity that haunts people in their sleep. She brushes aside his admonition, but when a terrifying entity begins to haunt Kate's friends and loved ones, she must fight to stay awake to stop the nightmare she's unleashed.

programme.title: Doppelganger [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A writer with a room for rent acquires a strange new roommate with a psychotic alter-ego that follows her wherever she goes.

programme.title: Derailed [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Secret agent Kristoff (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is assigned to escort Galina Konstantin (Laura Elena Harring), a thief in possession of a deadly virus, on a train journey that unluckily falls on his birthday. Kristoff tells his disappointed wife, son and daughter that he's taking a business trip. They decide to sneak aboard the train as a surprise, only to suspect he's having an affair with the mysterious Galina. To make matters much worse, terrorists hijack the train and go after the virus.

programme.title: Transsiberian
programme.desc: On their way home from China, married Christian missionaries Roy (Woody Harrelson) and Jessie (Emily Mortimer) take a train from Beijing to Moscow. On board, they befriend Carlos (Eduardo Noriega) and Abby (Kate Mara). When Roy does not return in time at one stop, Jessie waits for him to catch up at the next station. Carlos and Abby stay with her, insisting the town is unsafe, however Carlos' attempts to "befriend" Jessie radically change the dynamic of the trip.

programme.title: Agent Red [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Captain Matt Hendricks and Dr. Linda Christian are locked in a submarine with Russian terrorists that threaten to launch a chemical virus on US territory.

programme.title: Duke Ellington
programme.sub-title: Duke Ellington: Jazz from Newport, Brussels, 1973
programme.desc: In 1956, Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed a legendary set at the third annual Newport Jazz Festival. It was tenor saxophonist Paul Gonsalves' outstanding 27-chorus solo on “Diminuendo and Crescendo in Blue” that revitalized Ellington's career. The success generated during that performance carried him for the rest of his life. By 1973, festivals carrying the Newport name were organized all over the world. Less than a year before his death, Ellington and his Orchestra, with Gonsalves still in the fold, appeared in Brussels to deliver a timeless performance before a highly appreciative crowd.

programme.title: Ray Charles & The Raelettes
programme.sub-title: Ray Charles and the Raelettes - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1980, American soul legend Ray Charles brought the Raelettes and the Ray Charles Orchestra to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. With the full force of these two groups behind him, Charles showed why throughout his storied career he has been viewed as one of the most recognizable voices in music.

programme.title: Elizabeth Shepherd
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Spyro Gyra
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, the American jazz fusion band Spyro Gyra took the stage at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Having struck gold with their album "Morning Dance" just a few years prior, they played a slick set with exuberant energy.

programme.title: Coleman Hawkins
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Wayne Shorter
programme.sub-title: Wayne Shorter Quintet - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano. Together with pianist Jim Beard, guitarist David Gilmore, bassist Alphonso Johnson, and drummer Rodney van Holmes, Shorter shows he is still at his best.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist's career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs “Autumn Leaves”, “Hackensack”, “My Favorite Things”, “I Want To Talk About You”, “Vigil”, and “Naima”. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: Art Farmer, Jim Hall, Steve Swallow & Pete La Roca
programme.sub-title: The Art Farmer Quartet live In England
programme.desc: Art Farmer: Live in '64 highlights an amazing one-hour concert featuring the great flugelhornist in his prime. Farmer's band includes legendary guitarist Jim Hall (fresh from Sonny Rollins' band), drummer Pete LaRoca, and Steve Swallow on bass. The legendary ensemble plays both standards and originals with ease and finesse and highlights why Farmer was considered one of the most innovative horn players in all of jazz.

programme.title: Bill Evans
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Isabelle Faust
programme.sub-title: Bach - Partita No. 2 and Sonata No. 3
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs two of J. S. Bach's incredible works for solo violin: Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004), and Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005). Both works are part of the composer's well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Partita No. 2 is made up of four dance movements, concluded by its famous Chaconne, a monumental piece within the violin repertoire. In this Chaconne, Bach develops a series of continuous variations from a theme, exploring a complex range of harmonic possibilities. Sonata No. 3 includes an extensive fugue in which Bach employs many contrapuntal techniques. In this wonderful performance, Faust shows her mastery of Bach's technically challenging pieces. This performance was recorded at St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, Germany, in 2020.

programme.title: Kevin John Edusei
programme.desc: In October 2020, German conductor Kevin John Edusei made his London Symphony Orchestra debut and leads the orchestra in a beautiful performance of the suite from Mendelssohn's “A Midsummer Night's Dream”, Boulanger's “D'un matin de printemps” and Schumann's 'Spring' Symphony. Edusei is regularly praised for the drama and tension that he brings to his music-making, and for his clear sense of architecture and attention to detail.

programme.title: Evgeny Kissin, Nikolai Demidenko, Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra & Antoni Wit
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010. Chopin composed the second concerto one year before the Concerto No. 1 and completed both works at the age of 20, before leaving his home country Poland and moving to Paris.

programme.title: Jonathon Heyward & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: American conductor Jonathon Heyward makes his debut with the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) with this performance of Antonín Dvořák's beloved Symphony No. 9 in E minor, Op. 95, "From the New World". Composed during Dvořák's stay in the United States, the work blends Bohemian warmth with the rhythms and spirit of American musical traditions. A deeply expressive and melodic masterpiece, it remains one of the most popular symphonies of all time. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke's on Old Street in London, UK, on September 30, 2020.

programme.title: Elena Bashkirova, Juliane Banse, Emmanuel Pahud & Claudio Bohorquez
programme.desc: The extraordinarily talented pianist Elena Bashkirova has been president of the Felix Mendelssohn-Bartholdy Foundation in Leipzig since October 2020, succeeding legendary conductor Kurt Masur. In this concert at the Mendelssohn House in Leipzig, Bashkirova is joined by soprano Juliane Banse, flutist Emmanuel Pahud, cellist Claudio Bohórquez, clarinettist Karl-Heinz Steffens, and pianist Ohad Ben-Ari in a chamber music program dedicated to the music of Mendelssohn and his sister Fanny Hensel. The program opens with Mendelssohn's Piano Trio in D minor, Op. 49. This is followed by a selection of songs: Mendelssohn's Schilflied ‘Auf dem Teich, dem regungslosen', Op. 71 No. 4, and Reiselied ‘Der Herbstwind rüttelt die Bäume', Op. 34 No. 6 Hensel's Vorwurf, Op. 10 No. 2 Verlust, Op. 9 No. 10 and Sehnsucht, Op. 9 No. 7 Mendelssohn's ‘Allnächtlich im Traume seh ich dich', Op. 86 No. 4 ‘Die Liebende schreibt', Op. 86 No. 3 and Nachtlied ‘Vergangen ist der lichte Tag', Op. 71 No. 6. The program continues with Mendelssohn's Seven Songs without Words, for piano four-hands (Op. 62 Nos. 1-6, and Op. 67 No. 1), and comes to a close with Mendelssohn's Three pieces for clarinet, violoncello and piano (arr. Ernst Naumann), comprising Prelude, Op. 35 No. 4, Songs without Words, Op. 53 No. 2, and Duet, Op. 38 No. 6. This performance was recorded in November 2020.

programme.title: Hans Zimmer
programme.desc: Hans Zimmer is one of the most successful film music composers working today. His multi-award winning career reaches back to the mid-eighties and he has developed close working relationships with renowned directors such as Ridley Scott, Tony Scott, Michael Bay, Ron Howard, Gore Verbinski and Christopher Nolan. His credits include some of the biggest blockbuster movies and most acclaimed TV series of all time. This concert was filmed on 7th May 2016 in Prague during Hans Zimmer's hugely successful European concert tour. Hans was accompanied by a band, orchestra and choir, 72 musicians in total, including guest guitarist Johnny Marr. The staging was spectacular with a ground breaking light show, stunning visuals and a state of the art sound system. With Hans Zimmer performing on multiple instruments and giving introductory insights to many of the pieces, this show is a treat for lovers of both great music and great movies.

programme.title: Diana Krall
programme.desc: Diana Krall has had a long time fascination with bossa nova, a type of music which perfectly suits her sophisticated yet sensual style. This culminated in her new studio album 'Quiet Nights' (released by Verve in spring 2009) and in this stunning concert filmed in the home of the bossa nova, Rio de Janeiro, in November 2008. Accompanied by her band and an orchestra, Diana Krall delivers a superb live performance of standards in true bossa nova style but clearly bearing her unique stamp. This concert captures Diana Krall at her scintillating best.

programme.title: Deep Purple
programme.desc: Filmed in the spectacular surroundings of the Arena di Verona, a Roman amphitheater originally built in 30 AD, this concert from the summer of 2011 sees Deep Purple joined on stage by a full symphony orchestra for performances of all their classic tracks. Deep Purple remains one of the finest hard rock bands on the planet and are undoubtedly at their best when performing live. Here, the orchestral arrangements give an added depth and range to the familiar songs. The band responds to both playing with the orchestra and performing in such a historical location to deliver a brilliant show in front of a huge and enthusiastic crowd.

programme.desc: Nazaret en la actualidad: una pareja de ancianos vive cansada del ritmo de su rutina diaria. En el otro lado de la frontera, en Ramallah, su hijo desea seguir siendo un eterno soltero, su hija está a punto de dar a luz mientras el marido de esta consigue un papel en una película.

programme.title: El hombre más buscado
programme.desc: Sobria película de espías a la vieja escuela llena de tensión y suspense. Un joven ruso sin papeles consigue llegar a la ciudad de Hamburgo. Lleva encima una sorprendente cantidad de dinero. Annabel, una abogada defensora de derechos civiles, intenta que no lo deporten.

programme.title: Novia por conveniencia
programme.desc: Una novia rusa que quiere conseguir el permiso de residencia es encargada por correo.

programme.title: Amor a Primera Visa
programme.desc: Tras su fiesta de despedida, despierta en el apartamento de un apuesto mariachi y padre soltero.

programme.title: Palm Springs
programme.desc: Dos desconocidos atrapados en un bucle temporal.

programme.title: Todo es relativo
programme.desc: Harry ama a Grace, pero un secreto familiar convierte su historia de amor en una pesadilla.

programme.title: Novia por conveniencia
programme.desc: Una novia rusa que quiere conseguir el permiso de residencia es encargada por correo.

programme.title: Un precio justo
programme.desc: Kendall se muda a los suburbios de Nueva York para trabajar en la prestigiosa Atlantic Shores Realtors e inmediatamente choca con Brooke, una agente rival. Las tensiones pronto aumentarán.

programme.title: Amanece en Edimburgo
programme.desc: Davy y Ally vuelven a sus vidas en Edimburgo tras cumplir el servicio en la guerra. Ambos continúan sus relaciones de pareja. Todo va bien hasta que una revelación del pasado de Rab amenaza con destruir a la familia.

programme.title: El velo pintado
programme.desc: Walter y Kitty son una pareja de ingleses que deciden casarse por motivos equivocados y se establecen en Shanghai. En esta exótica ciudad, ella se enamora de otro hombre.

programme.title: Chungking Express
programme.desc: Dos historias de amor en un popular barrio turístico de Hong Kong. La primera describe el encuentro entre un joven policía y una misteriosa mujer fatal traficante de drogas. La segunda entre un solitario agente de policía y la joven camarera del bar donde aquél suele comer.

programme.title: Egoshooter
programme.desc: Jakob, de diecinueve años de edad, vive en Colonia y comparte piso con su hermano y la novia de éste, Karo, que está embarazada.

programme.title: Barbara
programme.desc: Brigitte, una actriz reconocida internacionalmente, llega a París para interpretar en una película a la icónica cantante francesa Barbara. A medida que pasan los días, la realidad y la ficción se irán confundiendo para el equipo de rodaje y también para la propia actriz.

programme.title: Envidia sana
programme.desc: Léa, Marc, Karine y Francis son dos parejas de viejos amigos. Se reúnen con frecuencia y todo funciona porque cada uno ocupa su lugar.

programme.title: La Flauta Mágica de Kenneth Branagh (V.O.S.E)
programme.desc: Antes de la Primera Guerra Mundial, en un mundo oscuro y siniestro, Tamino emprende un arriesgado viaje para liberar a Pamina.

programme.title: Cambio de rumbo
programme.desc: Rupert tiene 24 horas para cambiar radicalmente su vida o perder a Alison, la mujer a la que ama.

programme.title: Incidencias
programme.desc: Los pasajeros de un tren comienzan a enfrentarse en medio de la nada durante un clima peligroso.

programme.title: Concursante
programme.desc: Martín Circo Martín, acaba de convertirse en el ganador del mayor premio de la historia de la televisión.

programme.title: La boda de Rosa
programme.desc: A punto de cumplir 45 años, Rosa decide dejarlo todo atrás y tomar las riendas de su vida.

programme.title: Operación Concha
programme.desc: Un estafador atrae a un inversor contratando a un doble de una estrella de cine.

programme.title: Un hombre llamado Ove
programme.desc: Ove no es el típico vecino con el que apetece cruzarte en el barrio. Es un cascarrabias, un pesado que insiste hasta la exageración en mantener el orden y la disciplina, un casi sesentón solitario y resentido a quien el destino ha arrebatado demasiadas cosas.

programme.title: La guerra de los abuelos
programme.desc: Gerri es un abuelo atento y cariñoso, vive con la familia de su hija, ayuda en la casa y cuida de sus nietos. El abuelo Tom irrumpe en este perfecto equilibrio familiar, regresando a Italia después de años de vivir en el extranjero.

programme.title: St. Vincent
programme.desc: Con 2 nominaciones a los Globos de Oro y con un trío cómico protagonista impecable, 'St. Vincent' cuenta la historia de un chico cuyos padres se acaban de divorciar. La situación no es sencilla para él, le cuesta aceptar la nueva realidad. Sin embargo, las cosas cambian cuando conoce a su vecino.

programme.title: Fingiendo ser punk
programme.desc: En 1979, Angus, con el apoyo de su padre, descubre la escena musical underground post-punk de Christchurch, Nueva Zelanda, y supera sus dudas, las burlas y una tragedia familiar para subirse al escenario.

programme.title: La Chica De Mis Sueños
programme.desc: Una comedia romántica adolescente sobre la búsqueda de la pareja ideal, solo para descubrir que la realidad no está a la altura de la fantasía. Protagonizada por Shane West y James Franco.

programme.title: Uno Más De La Familia
programme.desc: Basada en el best-seller A Dog´s Way Purpose, la novela que narra las aventuras de Bella, una perrita que se embarca en una épica aventura de regreso a casa recorriendo un largo camino después de que la separen de su amo.

programme.title: The Animal (2001)
programme.desc: Puede que no parezca mucho, pero lo que cuenta está dentro. El genio de la comedia Rob Schneider (Deuce Bigalow: Male Gigolo, Big Daddy), Colleen Haskell del concurso de televisión Survivor, John C. McGinley (Any Given Sunday, The Rock) y Edward Asner (The Bachelor, JFK) aparecen en la comedia más escandalosa e histérica del año. Cuando el guardia de seguridad Marvin Mange (Schneider) responde a una llamada de emergencia sobre un robo en progreso, su sueño de convertirse en policía podría convertirse en realidad. Pero un extraño accidente de tráfico en su camino al lugar del crimen deja a Martin y a su sueño destrozados. Cuando Marvin se despierta una semana después, descubre que un científico desquiciado secretamente ha usado órganos de animales para reconstruir su cuerpo. Con nuevas energías gracias a sus nuevas y mejoradas partes, Marvin consigue fama al instante como superpolicía hasta que su instinto animal empieza a apoderarse de su cuerpo en los peores momentos. Y cuando se enamora de la encantadora y sexy Rianna (Haskell), ¡es magnetismo animal en su máxima expresión en la comedia más divertida y salvaje del año! No te pierdas a Rob Schneider en Big Daddy.

programme.title: Click (2006)
programme.desc: Un hostigado adicto al trabajo, Michael Newman (Adam Sandler) no tiene tiempo para su esposa (Kate Beckinsale) e hijos, y tampoco para impresionar a su ingrato jefe y ganarse un ascenso bien merecido. Así que cuando conoce a Morty (Christopher Walken), chiflado vendedor, recibe la respuesta a todas sus oraciones: un control remoto mágico que le permite evitar las pequeñas distracciones de la vida con resultados para morirse de la risa. Pero mientras Michael alegremente silencia, salta o escanea los momentos familiares y con sus amigos, el control gradualmente toma control sobre su vida y empieza a programarlo, en esta rápida, hilarante y alocada aventura cómica.

programme.title: El niño y el potro
programme.desc: En un pueblo de Galicia vive trabajando la tierra un hombre joven, Andrés, que quedó viudo con la única compañía de su hijo, Andresiño. En la doma de caballos salvajes, Fuco es competidor de Andrés, y quiere ante éste lucir su fuerza para ganarse la admiración de Ana, la joven maestra del pueblo. Tampoco Andrés oculta su admiración por la maestra de Andresiño. Hay otro "personaje" en la historia, Benito, gracioso potrillo del que Andresiño procura no separarse nunca. Fuco se muestra resentido porque Andrés y la maestra han iniciado una relación muy cordial, que se hace cada día más frecuente. Ana tiene, además como alumno más aventajado, a Andresiño.

programme.title: No Me Entierren
programme.desc: Dos mujeres ocultan la sorprendente verdad mientras un sheriff investiga un asesinato.

programme.title: Cuando habla el corazón
programme.desc: La amistad de dos amigos inseparables se ve amenazada cuando uno de ellos se ve involucrado, sin saberlo, en una situación que afecta a la hermana del otro. Cuando la verdad sale a la luz, su lealtad y amistad deberán superar una difícil prueba.

programme.title: A flechas y fuego
programme.desc: El Príncipe del Petróleo, un estafador sin escrúpulos, vende al banco unos inexistentes pozos de petróleo y desvía a unos colonos para favorecer sus planes. Sin embargo, su fraude se ve amenazado cuando Winnetou y su hermano de sangre, Old Surehand, intervienen para proteger a los inocentes y desenmascarar la conspiración.

programme.title: Los rastreadores
programme.desc: Cuando la hija de un ranchero es secuestrada por los apaches, forma un grupo y envía a buscar al mariscal de EE.UU., pero en su lugar aparece un mariscal adjunto afroamericano.

programme.title: El ángel vengador
programme.desc: Un predicador se convierte en cazarrecompensas después de que un grupo de refugiados que busca cobijo en su iglesia sea asesinado por una banda de despiadados forajidos.

programme.title: ¿Quién manda?
programme.desc: Alex con temor al compromiso, tiene una interesante teoría: salir con una mujer únicamente durante 3 meses. En el camino conoce a Natalie y entonces sabrá que el amor llega cuando menos se espera.

programme.title: Lleno de ruido y dolor
programme.desc: Soria se une a dos bandidos para robar un banco de un pequeño pueblo de la Patagonia. Pronto se da cuenta de que ha cometido el mayor error de su vida cuando se ve obligado a matar a un inocente.

programme.title: Pasos firmes
programme.desc: Gustavo, un joven corredor ciego, pierde a su compañero de entrenamiento y comienza a entrenar con Dany, un chico que enfrenta una vida difícil, mientras ambos descubren la fuerza de la amistad y la superación personal.

programme.title: Misterios amish de Sugar Creek
programme.desc: Tras una ruptura devastadora, Cheryl deja Chicago y se refugia en Sugarcreek, una pequeña comunidad amish de Ohio. Mientras lucha por adaptarse, descubre un inquietante secreto que amenaza la tranquilidad del pueblo. En su búsqueda de respuestas, encontrará amistad, un nuevo sentido de pertenencia y la posibilidad de volver a enamorarse.

programme.title: Romance a la fuga
programme.desc: Ann llega a Los Ángeles para trabajar en catering, pero termina convertida en estrella de un reality junto a su novio Scott. Cuando sus planes de boda se desmoronan, huye a Pensilvania y queda varada en un pueblo amish. Allí conoce a Hunter y descubre una vida diferente, mientras la productora intenta encontrarla para recuperar la audiencia.

programme.title: El pequeño Nicolás
programme.desc: Inclinados sobre un gran folio en blanco en algún lugar entre Montmartre y Saint-Germain-des-Prés, Jean-Jacques Sempé y René Goscinny dan vida a El pequeño Nicolás, un niño risueño y travieso. La suya es una infancia alegre, llena de juegos, diversión, bromas, aprendizaje, complicidad, peleas y castigos. Las aventuras de Nicolás le llevan al estudio de sus creadores, donde habla con ellos de forma distendida. Sempé y Goscinny le cuentan cómo se conocieron y se hicieron amigos, y también responden a preguntas sobre su carrera, su infancia y sus ambiciones.

programme.title: La abeja Maya. La película
programme.desc: La curiosa abeja Maya y su amigo Willy salvarán a la colmena de la avaricia del consejero de la reina y pondrán fin a años de hostilidad entre abejas y avispas. Maya es una abeja recién nacida muy vivaracha que no sigue las reglas de la colmena, entre ellas la de no confiar en las avispas que viven más allá de la pradera. Cuando desaparece la jalea real, las avispas son las principales sospechosas y las abejas señalan a Maya como cómplice del robo. Ninguna de sus compañeras cree en su inocencia y Willy, su mejor amigo, será su único apoyo. Juntos se embarcarán en un largo viaje lleno de aventuras hasta la colmena de las avispas para encontrar al verdadero culpable. Gracias a Maya y Willy por fin reinará la amistad entre todos los residentes de la opulenta pradera.

programme.title: Mañana, cuando la guerra empiece
programme.desc: Cuando su país es invadido y sus familias secuestradas, ocho adolescentes se unen para luchar.

programme.title: Jake
programme.desc: Una pareja casada, Alex y Greg, tiene que afrontar un conflicto cuando descubre que su hijo prefiere a la Cenicienta en lugar de los G.I. Joe.

programme.title: Alpha
programme.desc: Alpha son tres jóvenes amigos criminales que se separaron en un momento determinado de su vida debido a un robo fallido. Ocho años después vuelven a estar juntos, cada uno eligiendo diferentes estilos de vida.

programme.title: La Mujer sin Piano
programme.desc: Un ama de casa casada para la que no hay nada comparable a la íntima satisfacción de ver el plato humeante servido con admirable puntualidad a la hora de la comida. Veinticuatro horas de su vida de la que una noche decide escapar, y cuenta todo lo que le pasa en esta fuga.

programme.title: Negociador
programme.desc: Comedia basada en las negociaciones entre el presidente del PSE vasco, Jesús Eguiguren y ETA en 2005 y 2006.

programme.title: El invierno de las anjanas
programme.desc: Adelaida pierde a su novio Eusebio en la Guerra de Cuba. Al no asumir la ausencia de Eusebio, la joven es ingresada en un sanatorio para enfermos mentales. En su reclusión, Adelaida rememora los recuerdos de su vida con Eusebio...

programme.title: Blood Riders: The Devil Rides With Us
programme.desc: Blood Riders is a blood soaked adventure comedy about 4 young friends who stumble upon a body after stealing a car. That discovery pushes the friends on a road trip around town during which they try get rid of the increasing amount of corpses. Along their wild ride the kids encounter neo-Nazis, punk artists, devil worshipers and a plan to resurrect Hitler.

programme.title: Chain Letter
programme.desc: Six friends receive a mysterious chain letter via text and email from a maniac who hunts down those who delete the message. Who knew they should take the threats in the chain letter seriously or that their favorite technologies could help track and kill them? This maniacal game pits friend against friend as they try to escape the impossible. Break the chain, lose a life.

programme.title: Los misterios de Fixer Upper
programme.desc: Shannon Hughes y Mark Sullivan investigan la misteriosa muerte de un hombre muy querido en la ciudad al que le gustaba contar historias y buscar tesoros.

programme.title: Blood Honey
programme.desc: Tortured by the memory of a childhood trauma, a woman returns after a decade to her family's fly-in hunting lodge to assist her siblings with their dying father, only to find herself stuck in a life threatening nightmare.

programme.title: Becoming Evil: Cult of Personality: The Monster Within and Among Us
programme.desc: Episode One discusses 'The Monster Within And Among Us', and discusses Jack The Ripper (even though he's not American), since he is pretty much the first recognized serial killer. Since a lack of real footage is obvious, this episode uses footage from an old black and white move, loosely based on Jack The Ripper.

programme.title: Tombstone Rashomon
programme.desc: The Tombstone story told in the style of the Japanese classic "Rashomon", where we see history from several perspectives including that of Wyatt Earp, Doc Holliday, Kate, Ike Clanton, Colonel Hafford and Johnny Behan.

programme.title: Problemas en el Paraiso
programme.desc: Rachel, una reciente viuda, viaja de regreso a Estados Unidos en un barco de carga con el cuerpo de su esposo cuando el barco naufraga en una isla desierta. Solo hay otro sobreviviente y ambos están decididos a ser rescatados. Tras una serie de eventos extremos, finalmente son encontrados, pero por su esposo, quien había fingido su muerte.

programme.title: Asesino de tiburones
programme.desc: Los servicios del asesino de tiburones Chase Walker han sido contratados por su hermano Jake, jefe de una banda criminal de la Costa Oeste. El trabajo: matar al tiburón de aleta negra que se tragó un valioso diamante durante una transacción entre bandas. Para vigilar a Chase, se alista a Jasmine, colega de Jake. Pero la relación entre Chase y Jasmine se profundiza con las amenazas de un jefe rival: llevarle el diamante o morir. Pronto, las lealtades cambiarán, y Chase aprenderá que confiar en la sangre es para tontos. Ahora, se enfrentan jefes contra jefes, hermanos contra hermanos y el hombre contra la naturaleza, mientras Chase se esfuerza por rescatar a Jasmine, salvar su propia vida y rastrear al gran tiburón de aleta negra que será el mayor desafío de su carrera.

programme.title: Corrupción policial
programme.desc: Un policía negro descubre una célula de vigilantes supremacistas blancos dentro de su departamento.

programme.title: H4zard
programme.desc: Sigue a Noah, quien realmente ama a su novia, a su hija y a su coche, pero después de aceptar un trabajo como conductor, se ve envuelto en una carrera que podría costarle la vida, su familia o su querido automóvil.

programme.title: A ciegas
programme.desc: A police inspector has to solve two gruesome murders. The problem is, his only suspect is a blind man.

programme.title: Junglee: Alma Salvaje
programme.desc: Un veterano de guerra vuelve a casa, a la reserva de elefantes de su padre, donde tendrá que luchar contra unos cazadores furtivos.

programme.title: Power Rangers
programme.desc: Musculoso y espectacular reboot de la mítica serie de los 90' a medio camino entre 'Transformers' y el cine de superhéroes. 5 jóvenes estudiantes van a descubrir que La Tierra está al borde de la extinción por una amenaza alienígena. Pronto descubrirán que son los únicos que pueden salvar el planeta

programme.title: Código fuente
programme.desc: ¿Es posible viajar en el tiempo para evitar una catástrofe? El capitán Colter Stevens (Jake Gyllenhaal) tiene la difícil misión de conseguirlo en esta eficaz película de acción y ciencia-ficción considerada como una de las mejores películas del género de los últimos años.

programme.title: Pompeya
programme.desc: Pompeya, año 79 d.C. Milo (Kit Harington, Jon Snow en 'Juego de Tronos'), un esclavo convertido en gladiador, ve cómo a su amor, la joven Cassia, la obligan a prometerse con Corvus, un corrupto senador. Cuando el Vesubio entra en erupción, Milo intentará salvarla... mientras todo se derrumba.

programme.title: Vencer o Morir
programme.desc: 1793: el exmarinero Charette lidera una apasionada revuelta campesina contra la Revolución Francesa.

programme.title: Operación Lobo
programme.desc: Versión cinematográfica de la serie Netflix: una unidad policial combate para frenar un golpe de Estado.

programme.title: El ataque del tiburón de seis cabezas

Ahora, sin poderes superhumanos, se unirá a sus compañeros supervivientes Claire y Chris (Ali Larter y Wentworth Miller) para enfrentarse a los ejércitos de los no-muertos y acabar con la Corporación Umbrella cuyo virus los ha creado.
